{{Quote|The recording device has captured the images and the sounds of the struggle so that future generations will remember.|A Jedi Council member acting as narrator|audio=NabooCrisisRecord.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (book-and-record)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (book-and-record)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' book-and-record]]</ref>}}
A '''narrated record''' of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] was created by the members of a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] in order to preserve the memory of that fateful conflict. [[Unidentified Jedi Council member (narrator)|One]] of the Council's members provided a narrative account of the events based on many recorded sounds and pictures taken throughout the crisis.
